summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea, with a history of recent C. difficile infection. She presented with symptoms consistent with a recurrence and was found to have a positive C. difficile PCR test. She was treated with oral vancomycin on a tapering schedule, received IV fluids for hydration, and was monitored for electrolyte imbalances. Her symptoms improved, she advanced to a soft diet, and was able to tolerate oral intake by discharge. Chronic abdominal pain remained stable and was managed with non-opioid medications. She was discharged home with instructions to complete the vancomycin course, avoid restarting constipation medications until diarrhea resolved, and follow up with her primary care and gastroenterology providers.
